description: This file defines a utility object 'KeyboardUtils' with a method to show the keyboard for a given EditText in an Android application, incorporating a delay to handle focus animations.

classes.name: KeyboardUtils
classes.description: A utility singleton object providing a method to display the soft keyboard for a specified EditText.

methods.name: showKeyboardForEditText
methods.description: Displays the soft input keyboard for the provided EditText after requesting focus and a short delay to accommodate focus animations.

parameters.name: editText
parameters.description: The EditText view for which the keyboard should be shown.
